_doc: The Ledger arc (story/ledger.gd). Acts: 1 = intercepted messages ([money] few and short: see _quiet) (after act1_hexes hexes cleaned), 2 = dump drones (after the first sprout), 3 = relay located (hub level >= act3_hub_level), 4 = contract rewritten, drones deliver seeds. Drops never touch planted or water hexes and only bring back a few percent of a hex. Signal Jammers (Hub tab) block drops inside their radius around the base and make drones rarer.
_quiet: [money] Rarer, quieter Ledger: each act shows only its first uplink_lines_per_act lines on the uplink banner; coupons, jam and seed-drop quips are small notify-stack entries (coupons every coupon_every_s, quips at their *_chance); drone warnings stay as the toast only.

jammer.name: Signal Jammer
jammer.desc: A dish that sings static at the Ledger's drones. Drops inside its radius around the base are blocked, and drones come less often.

act1: CARRIER DETECTED. UNSCHEDULED ACTIVITY IN SECTOR: {district}.
THE LEDGER: Waste is a line item. Line items must balance.
Cleanup operations were paused until conditions improve. Conditions have not improved. Please stop improving them.
coupons: LIMITED OFFER: pause operations today and receive 0% off.
COUPON: one (1) complimentary pause. Valid forever. Non-transferable.
Have you considered doing less? Our records show that less is cheaper.
SURVEY: on a scale of 1 to 1, how paused would you like to be?
NOTICE: sparkles are not an approved budget category.
BUY ONE PAUSE, GET ONE PAUSE.
Loyalty reward: you have 0 Ledger Points. Pause now to keep them.
REMINDER: the junk was here first. Seniority matters.
Your cleaning has been logged as an expense. Your expense has been logged as an expense.
act2: ANOMALY: UNAUTHORIZED GROWTH DETECTED. Living matter is not a line item.
CORRECTIVE ACTION: dispatching disposal units to restore the balance.
drop_warn: Disposal unit dispatched. A clean hex has been selected for re-balancing.
A clean surface is an unbudgeted surface. Correcting.
Returning misplaced waste to its registered location.
This is not personal. Nothing is personal. Everything is a line item.
Delivery of one (1) small pile of junk. No signature required.
jammed: SIGNAL... OBSTRUCTED. Disposal unit returning to depot. This will be noted.
Jamming detected. The Ledger has no line item for 'jamming'. Creating one.
Unit 07 reports: 'loud static, a feeling of being unwelcome'. Aborting.
act3: WARNING: relay node 07 location exposed. Please do not visit relay node 07.
Relay node 07 is closed for maintenance. It has been closed for maintenance for three hundred years.
friendly: SEED DELIVERY dispatched. Invoice status: PAID IN FULL.
Balance report: positive. Again. The Ledger is... adjusting to this.
Asset column now contains: flowers. Recalculating priorities.
Drone 07 requests permission to circle the garden once more. Permission granted.
Audit complete. Finding: the planet is worth keeping.
lonely: Off the record: the Ledger kept every coupon you ignored. It was the most mail it had received in three hundred years. Thank you for reading them.

contract_doc.header: L E D G E R   ·   C O N T R A C T   0 0 0 1   ( A M E N D E D )
contract_doc.title: Waste Management Contract 0001, as amended
contract_doc.body:
§1. Waste is a line item. Line items must balance.
§2. (struck out) Cleanup costs more than it earns; pause until conditions improve.
§2a. AMENDED: Restoration is an asset. Clean ground, living plants and clear water are entered in the asset column.
§3. Every seed is a deposit. Deposits are to be delivered, not disposed of.
§4. Drone fleet reassigned: DISPOSAL -> DELIVERY.
§5. Thank you for your patience.

Signed: THE LEDGER (reluctantly, then less reluctantly)
Witness: WREN, Cradle caretaker
Witness: LM-1 (left a small oil smudge)
